name: Hearts
tagline: Dodge the hearts and the Queen of Spades — or shoot the moon.
rulesSummary: Pass three cards (left, right, across, then no pass), then play 13 tricks.
Follow suit if you can. The 2♣ leads the first trick.
Each heart is 1 point, the Q♠ is 13. Lowest score wins when someone reaches the target.
Take all 26 points to shoot the moon: everyone else gets 26 instead.
